snippet.title: Game Boy Color Longplay [129] Blade
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: xRavenXP

This is the longplay of the game Blade, this is the version released for Game Boy Color in 2000 only in North America.
The game is based on the 1998 movie and the character Blade is starring Wesley Snipes and this character is a hybrid of human and vampire.
The game Blade has 3 types of gameplay, the first is shooting gallery (where it is necessary to aim and shoot the screen), the second is beat'n up (only with bare hands) and the third is fight against the bosses (fight with the sword). A bit obscure game! -
